text: PWR Advanced Cooling Technology is the trading name of PWR Holdings Limited, founded as Paul Weel Radiators by Kees Weel and his son Paul Weel and listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (code PWH) since November 2015. Its FY2026 annual report's twenty-largest-holders table (31 July 2026) is led by nominee and custodian companies, with Weel-family entities Wagon Weel Co Pty Ltd (9.94%) and KPW Property Holdings Pty Ltd (6.71%); no state or state fund appears.
short: PWR is ASX-listed; its register is led by nominees plus Weel-family entities; no state.
